verdict.rationale: Statsig explicitly versions the Console API: callers select a dated version (20240601) via the STATSIG-API-VERSION header, Statsig guarantees each version won't break existing usage, and it publishes a versioned OpenAPI spec that it commits to keeping up to date. The evidence does not show a documented deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods, or support windows for old versions, and only one version exists so far. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, versioning evidence for the HTTP/evaluation API beyond the Console API, independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Statsig versions the Console API. Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage; each new version introduces breaking changes. There is only one version: 20240601.
Pass the version in the `STATSIG-API-VERSION` field in the header. This field is optional but becomes required in the future.
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
